articles.title: Raiders fans deliver emotional tribute to Fernando Mendoza’s mother after his first NFL touchdown
articles.summary: A moment of pure respect and solidarity unfolded in Las Vegas after rookie quarterback Fernando Mendoza scored his first career NFL touchdown. Thousands of Raiders fans chose to remain seated rather than jump to their feet and celebrate, honoring the way Mendoza’s family shares these special moments. His mother, Elsa, lives with multiple sclerosis and uses a wheelchair, meaning Fernando’s parents typically remain seated so they can celebrate together. By following their example, the Raiders faithful turned a touchdown celebration into a heartfelt gesture of support. Mendoza was visibly touched by the tribute, showing just how much the moment meant to him and his family.
